responsibility: Contains the RTL patterns and expanders for function entry/exit on the M32C backend, including normal prologue/epilogue generation, exception-return support, interrupt return forms, frame setup/teardown via enter/exitd, and helper pushm/popm/fset patterns used by m32c_emit_prologue and m32c_emit_epilogue. It supplies the assembler-level contracts that describe how stack pointer, frame pointer, and return control are updated for both A16 and A24 variants.
